description: Moving in scaffolding: walking into a column from the side (it has no sides); climbing it from inside with jump held until standing on its top; sneaking down through it to the ground; dropping onto a piece reaching out from the top, unsupported, whose thin floor holds the player even while sneaking; walking off it.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
